description: A CI step that runs baseline and candidate on the same dataset and blocks the change when the candidate is worse beyond noise.
The results of the version running today, stored with its settings, against which every candidate is compared.
How much the pass rate moves between runs of the same version (an A/A comparison). The gate's tolerance must exceed it.
The expected spread of a measured pass rate: about `√(p(1 − p) / n)` for `n` runs. Four times the runs halve it.
A case that passes in some repeated runs and fails in others. Users meet both outcomes, so it is a finding, not noise to hide.
A case that must not regress even when the average improves: a policy rule, a safety refusal, a key customer workflow.
Each case's pass rate in baseline and candidate, so a report says what got better and what broke instead of one delta.
